notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Orc Attack: Flatulent Rebellion, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Orc Attack: Flatulent Rebellion is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Orcs have become victims of brutal Human expansion, as they are carelessly poisoning the environment. Now, four trained Orc heroes are retaliating with a Not-So-Silent yet very deadly plan.

*Offer ends May 22 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Orc Attack Get's a Launch Day!
notes.notes: Orc Attack: Flatulent Rebellion is launching on Steam Thursday, May 15th. Fully geared for cooperative PC play, gamers will fart or die in this one- to four-player cooperative gas-and-slash action game.
